The grouping overview explains that the AEGB Letter of Intent is required at site plan stage for sites zoned CBD or DMU under Downtown Design (LDC § 25-2-593(B)). The site is zoned Commercial Services with Vertical Mixed Use combining districts (CS-V) and either Density Bonus 90 (DB90) or Conditional Overlay (CO) - none of which are CBD or DMU base zoning districts. The submitted application explicitly confirms that Green Building Program Rating is not required. Since the conditional trigger (CBD or DMU zoning) is not met, this checklist item does not apply to this site plan.
